name: Forno Acqua MultiSINK Stainless Steel Dual Mount Kit with Integrated Waterfall Rinsing and Glass Washing Station
shortDescription: Elevate your kitchen with the MultiSINK Kit – an innovative, all-in-one solution with three working levels and custom-fit accessories for unmatched versatility and Freedom! Seamlessly wash, prep, and dry at a single station. Features include a powerful Glass Washer for spotless drinkware, an integrated pivoting WaterWALL for effortless rinsing, and space-maximizing on-deck Drying Stations. The 3-function Chef faucet with boost-blade cleaning ensures everyday tasks are more efficient, cleaner, and effortlessly enjoyable.
